item.title: Lake Towada: Aomori's Crater Lake & Boat Tours — Guide
item.description: Lake Towada is a double volcanic crater lake of astonishing clarity, sitting 320 m above sea level on the Aomori–Akita border. The lakeside ‘Maidens’ statue, a 50-minute sightseeing cruise, and some of Japan’s finest mid-October foliage make it the natural climax of a Towada–Oirase trip. 🗓️ At a Glance Location Towada, Aomori (Akita border) Hours Lake open; cruises ~9:00–16:00 Admission Free; cruise ~¥1,500 Time needed 1.
